requirements.accept: Populated migration 4 to 5 preserves every old row, issued graph and ledger entry; idempotence and failed-upgrade rollback execute.
Explicit scenario/source-reference admission uses existing case identities and an issued snapshot. Raw/incomplete source records do not become managed cases or native knowledge artifacts.
Per-version source, locator, interpretation and narrative are immutable; exact context versions are pinned when explicitly supplied, and unknown context stays unasserted.

Preserve multiple identities, cases, versions, documentary sources and disagreements. Query and native RDF answer fixed independent oracles; no current/authoritative/occurrence/causation/endorsement inference.
Schema/ledger/hash/FK/payload and semantic audits reject drift and tampered restore; reopen, backup and dump restoration preserve original graphs and branch history.
Account for all 306 native elements with bounded support and explicit omissions; preserve historical 250 incomplete mappings, 11 external elements and all 11 original WITHHELD admissions.

policy.raw: Retain raw source_record.original_json without creating a RiskCase or managed scenario/source-reference.
policy.documentary_source: source_record is documentary provenance, not RiskSource or EvidenceReference admission.
policy.managed: Scenario requires >=1 existing case; source reference allows 0..* existing cases and 0..1 context. Scenario allows 0..* contexts with at most one pinned issued version per context artifact.
policy.versioning: Each graph is selected by exact issued version; no union/latest selection. New versions do not assert a native or general correction relationship.
policy.provenance: Narrative, documentary source, locator, interpretation and canonical UTC recorded time are immutable per issued version. Artifact origin may differ from a later version source.
policy.context: Only explicitly supplied, correctly typed issued context versions are accepted. Unknown is empty, never invented.
policy.publication: Separately versioned development component; stable v0.3.3 and all selected inputs remain unchanged.
